expectedRealization.rationale: The 330-day policy can lower coal costs for downstream thermal power within a quarter, but Huaneng's tariff/volume/market-power headwinds make the net earnings bridge uncertain.

changeHypothesis.summary: Coal supply policy shifted from shortage-inducing 276-day production toward broad 330-day production. This is adverse for coal-price continuation but can create a downstream fuel-cost exception for thermal power, subject to independent tariff/volume headwinds.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: The heating-season production relaxation can materially increase supply for months, but power-company benefit depends on tariff and utilization.
disconfirmingEvidence: The company cited lower coal-fired tariffs, lower volume and more market-priced power as independent headwinds.
Coal price normalization may not be enough to offset those headwinds.
